WITH country_codes AS (SELECT c.id, LEFT(c.iso_code, 2) AS code, tj_name AS name FROM q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t2 AS c)
SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, '10.7' AS transaction_type, '10.7' AS transaction_type_hidden, '10.7.1' AS transaction_subtype,
DATE(DATE_ADD(t.created_at, INTERVAL 5 HOUR)) AS transaction_date, 'TJS' AS currency, converted_amount AS amount, converted_amount AS amount_nc,
'Перевод с одного мобильного кошелька на другой' AS transaction_desc, 1 AS side_type, 1 AS side_subtype,
p.surname AS last_name, p.name AS first_name, p.patronymic AS middle_name, DATE(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', p.date_of_birth)) AS dob,
CASE WHEN p.passport_type_id IN (1, 2) THEN 1 WHEN p.passport_type_id = 3 THEN 4 WHEN p.passport_type_id = 4 THEN 5 END AS doc_type,
p.passport_id AS doc_number, DATE(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', p.date_of_issue)) AS date_of_issue,
COALESCE(citizenships.code, 'TJ') AS citizenship, REPLACE(mu.phone, '+', '') AS bank_account, COALESCE(q3_t2.code, 'TJ') AS country,
IF(r.name = 'Душанбе', 'Марказ', r.name) AS region, IF(r.name = 'Душанбе', 'Душанбе', dis.name) AS city, p.residential_address AS address,
4 AS side2_type, 1 AS side2_subtype, p2.surname AS side2_last_name, p2.name AS side2_first_name, p2.patronymic AS side2_middle_name,
date(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', p2.date_of_birth)) AS side2_dob,
CASE WHEN p2.passport_type_id IN (1,2) THEN 1 WHEN p2.passport_type_id = 3 THEN 4 WHEN p2.passport_type_id = 4 THEN 5 END AS side2_doc_type,
p2.passport_id AS side2_doc_number, date(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', p2.date_of_issue)) AS side2_date_of_issue,
COALESCE(citizenships2.code, 'TJ') AS side2_citizenship, REPLACE(mu2.phone, '+', '') AS side2_bank_account, COALESCE(countries2.code, 'TJ') AS side2_country,
IF(r2.name = 'Душанбе','Марказ', r2.name) AS side2_region, IF(r2.name = 'Душанбе','Душанбе', dis2.name) AS side2_city, p2.residential_address AS side2_address FROM q3_catalog.q3_db3.q3_t4 AS t
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db3.q3_t5 ah ON t.id = ah.tr_id and ah.operation_type = 'expense'
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db3.q3_t6 AS mu ON mu.id = t.user_id
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t7 AS d ON d.client_id = mu.crm_client_id AND d.document_status_id = 2
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t8 AS p ON p.document_id = d.id AND p.is_main = 1
LEFT JOIN country_codes AS citizenships ON p.citizenship_id = citizenships.id AND p.passport_type_id = 4
LEFT JOIN country_codes AS q3_t2 ON p.residential_country = q3_t2.name AND p.passport_type_id = 4
LEFT JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t9 AS r ON p.region_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t10 AS dis ON dis.id = p.district_id INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db3.q3_t6 AS mu2 ON mu2.id = t.user2_id
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t7 AS d2 ON d2.client_id = mu2.crm_client_id AND d2.document_status_id = 2
INNER JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t8 AS p2 ON p2.document_id = d2.id AND p2.is_main = 1
LEFT JOIN country_codes AS citizenships2 ON p2.citizenship_id = citizenships2.id AND p2.passport_type_id = 4
LEFT JOIN country_codes AS countries2 ON p2.residential_country = countries2.name AND p2.passport_type_id = 4
LEFT JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t9 AS r2 ON p2.region_id = r2.id
LEFT JOIN q3_catalog.q3_db1.q3_t10 AS dis2 ON dis2.id = p2.district_id WHERE DATE_ADD(t.created_at, INTERVAL 5 HOUR) >= '2025-01-12'
AND DATE_ADD(t.created_at, INTERVAL 5 HOUR) < '2025-01-13'
AND t.status = 'approved' AND t.source_acc_gate = 0 AND t.dest_acc_gate = 0 AND t.operation_type != 5 AND t.converted_amount >= 6000
